raw_segments.text: Next, since good may be either an active working or a state, those kappa yoda newta sigma epsilon
yoda sigma, or gamma epsilon new epsilon sigma epsilon yoda sigma, which tend to place
us in our natural state, are pleasant incidentally because of that tendency.
But the active working is really in the desires excited in the remaining—sound, part of
our state or nature, for there are pleasures which have no connection with pain or desire.
The acts of contemplative intellect, for instance, in which case there is no deficiency in the
nature or state of him who performs the acts.
